# ViLM

> Application charter for ViLM (layer 2). Inherits the Personal Constitution and shared SwiftUI standards. Page ID: 3afadcca-f428-8198-a6a9-f0603c01c2f8. Target platforms: macOS 14+ / iOS 17+.
## Intention
Native macOS and iOS video library management and media review application. Recursively indexes local video files into an embedded SQLite database (GRDB.swift), managing a full metadata graph of video assets, actors/entities (with aliases), tags, series, playlists, and smart collections—with video playback, contact sheet generation, duplicate detection, and review workflows—100% private and offline.
## Functionality
- **Library Scanning & Indexing: **Recursive indexing (LibraryScanner.swift) of .mp4, .mov, and .m4v video files. Uses relative paths, stable UUIDs, file-hash tracking, missing-file detection, and catalog schema migrations while preserving custom user metadata during rescans.
- **SQLite Persistence via GRDB: **High-performance SQLite engine (LibraryStore.swift) storing .catalog data alongside media files. Schema migrations for Assets, Actors, Tags, Playlists, Smart Collections, Series/Episodes, and Contact Sheets.
- **Rich Media Playback & Pop-Out Player: **Integrated AVPlayer (PlayerView.swift, PlayerPopoutView.swift, VideoPlaybackController.swift) supporting inline playback, pop-out macOS player window, 4×4 contact sheet frame seeking, and scene marker navigation (SceneMarker.swift).
- **Actor & Entity Metadata Graph: **Full entity profiles (EntityProfile.swift, ActorGridView.swift, ActorInspectorView.swift, ActorSync.swift) managing actor aliases (AKAs), profile photos, gallery images, biography text, nationality flags (CountryFlagHelper.swift), and automated filmography linking.
- **Smart Collections & Manual Playlists: **Saved live filter criteria (SmartCollection.swift) in the sidebar plus manual drag-and-drop ordered playlists (Playlist.swift, PlaylistDetailView.swift) backed by playlists and playlist_items schema tables.
- **Smart Shelves & Dashboard Analytics: **Executive library dashboard (DashboardView.swift, LibraryStatsView.swift) featuring 30-day library growth charts, unreviewed queues, recently added items, top-rated assets, and attention-needed actors.
- **Duplicate Video Analysis & Cleaning: **Automated detection (VideoDuplicateAnalyzer.swift, DuplicateDetectionView.swift) of exact and fuzzy duplicate video assets based on file size, duration, resolution, and hashes.
- **Contact Sheet & Thumbnail Engine: **Automated generation (ContactSheetService.swift) of 4×4 contact sheet preview grids allowing visual frame jumping directly into playback.
- **Series & Episode Organization: **Automated season/episode parsing (EpisodeParser.swift, SeriesCleanupView.swift) from file naming conventions (e.g. S01E05), episode backfilling, and series grouping.
- **Library Backup & Federation: **Catalog backup/restore (LibraryBackupService.swift), actor profile exports/imports (ActorLibraryPackage.swift .actorpkg), and multi-library attached session federation (LibraryFederation.swift).
## Major pages
- **Dashboard & Library Overview (DashboardView.swift): **Library stats, 30-day growth chart, unreviewed queue, smart shelves, and quick action entry points.
- **Asset Grid & Filter Builder (AssetGridView.swift, FilterBuilderView.swift): **High-performance asset grid with live search, star rating filters, tag/actor filtering, and saved Smart Collections.
- **Actor Directory & Inspector (ActorGridView.swift, ActorInspectorView.swift, EntityProfileEditorView.swift): **Entity profile management, alias handling, photo galleries, and filmography lists.
- **Video Player & Pop-Out Window (PlayerView.swift, PlayerPopoutView.swift, SceneMarkerViews.swift): **Full-featured player with 4×4 contact sheet frame jumping and scene markers.
- **Playlists & Shelf Detail View (PlaylistDetailView.swift, ShelfDetailView.swift): **Custom ordered playlists and horizontal smart shelf views.
- **Series Cleanup & Backfill (SeriesCleanupView.swift, EpisodeBackfillView.swift): **Automated TV/web series parsing and metadata tagging.
- **Duplicate Detection Workspace (DuplicateDetectionView.swift): **Interactive duplicate finder and resolution workspace.
- **File Name Auditor & Renamer (FileNameAuditView.swift, FileRenamerService.swift): **Bulk file renaming based on actor/title/date templates.
- **Library Settings & Backup (SettingsView.swift, LibraryBackupView.swift, ActorLibraryExportView.swift): **App settings, SQLite database backups, and actor package import/export.
## Architecture
Cleanly separated into a native SwiftUI application layer (ViLM/ViLM) and a pure, testable domain library core (LibraryCore Swift package at ViLM/LibraryCore). Persists data locally into an embedded SQLite database using GRDB.swift.
- **LibrarySession.swift — Central State: **Manages active library state, search criteria, filter state, and selection model across screens.
- **LibraryStore.swift — GRDB SQLite Persistence: **Embedded SQLite database engine managing schema migrations, relative path resolution, and zero-network local storage.
- **Decoupled Domain Services: **Domain services for scanning (LibraryScanner), contact sheet generation (ContactSheetService), duplicate detection (VideoDuplicateAnalyzer), video editing (VideoEditingService), file renaming (FileRenamerService), and library federation (LibraryFederation).
## Data model (SQLite via GRDB)
- **assets — Video Asset Master: **id (UUID), relative_path, file_name, status, created_at, tags, external_link, notes, rating, video_name, season_number, episode_number, episode, play_count, last_played_at. ⚠️ **Corrected 2026-08-01** — this entry previously claimed `file_size`, `duration`, `width`, `height`, `codec` and `modified_at` columns. Verified against `LibraryStore.swift:114-218`: **none of those exist.** File size and video dimensions are read from the filesystem and AVFoundation on demand, which is the subject of findings F5 and F6 in the *iOS Performance & Battery Optimization* spec — its Phase 3 adds those six columns, at which point this list must be updated again.
- **actors / entity_profiles — Actor & Entity Master: **id, name, aliases (JSON), bio, nationality, profile_image_filename, created_at, modified_at
- **tags & asset_tags — Tag Taxonomy: **id, name, asset_id, tag_id
- **playlists & playlist_items — User Playlists: **playlist_id, asset_id (no FK for multi-library compatibility), position, added_at
- **smart_collections — Live Filters: **id, name, filter_criteria_json
- **scene_markers & contact_sheets: **timecode bookmarks, 4×4 grid thumbnail paths, and frame timestamps
- **series & episodes — Series Groupings: **id, title, season_number, episode_number, asset_id
## Integrations
- **Local File System (Security-Scoped Bookmarks): **Direct macOS/iOS file access via security-scoped URL bookmarks.
- **AVKit / AVFoundation: **Native video decoding, playback, thumbnail extraction, and timecode seeking.
- **SQLite / GRDB: **Embedded high-performance relational database engine.
- **Actor Package (.actorpkg) Exporter/Importer: **Cross-library sharing of actor metadata and photos.
## Testing
Self-contained XCTest unit testing harness in ViLM/LibraryCore/Tests/LibraryCoreTests/. 22 unit test suites covering LibraryStore, LibraryScanner, VideoDuplicateAnalyzer, VideoEditingService, ContactSheetService, LibraryBackupService, Playlist, SceneMarker, AssetFilterCriteria, EpisodeParser, FileRenamerService, TagNormalizer, TagSuggester, MergeSemantics, ActorSync, LibraryFederation, LibraryDisplayName, ProfileImageNaming, QuickActionPicker, VideoTransferService, and ActorLibraryPackage.
